Title: Public preview: AIOps powered intelligent view in application maps

Body.Content:
There's always some degree of noise coming from "benign" failures in large distributed applications. We have added an Intelligent view on the application map feature that uses patented AIOps machine learning models to guide you to the root cause of the issue being investigated. The map now offers actionable insights by recommending which node to node edges need further investigation. 

Try it out by enabling the Intelligent view toggle and optionally change the sensitivity of the detections. We would appreciate your feedback—you can provide feedback using the Feedback button in the map in portal.

Read our documentation to learn more.
